new_jobs.title: Senior Operations Specialist
new_jobs.jd: Senior Operations Specialist About the Role We are looking for a **Senior Operations Specialist** to join our Operations team and drive cross-functional operational initiatives, internal projects, process improvements, and ERP-related execution. This role will work closely with the **Operations Director and cross-functional teams** to ensure operational priorities, projects, and process improvements are executed effectively and on schedule. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and execution-oriented, with strong project coordination, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Key Responsibilities **1. Operations & Project Coordination** * Drive and track daily operational initiatives and internal projects, including project plans, milestones, action items, and deliverables. * Coordinate cross-functional workstreams and ensure clear ownership, timelines, and deliverables. * Organize and facilitate cross-functional meetings, including agendas, materials, meeting notes, and follow-up actions. * Consolidate project progress, risks, issues, and dependencies for regular management reporting. * Identify execution gaps and delays, coordinate resolution, and escalate critical issues when necessary. **2. ERP & Operational Systems** * Drive and monitor ERP implementation and system enhancement projects across functional teams. * Coordinate data preparation, system testing, UAT, training, process validation, and go-live readiness. * Work with business users, IT teams, and system vendors to clarify requirements and drive issues to resolution. * Monitor ERP adoption and identify gaps between system capabilities and business processes. * Maintain ERP project plans, issue logs, process documentation, requirements, and management reports. **3. Process Improvement & Operational Governance** * Review existing operational processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and efficiency improvement. * Coordinate the development and implementation of SOPs, workflows, and operating procedures. * Support operational governance, including process ownership, controls, and performance tracking. * Drive cross-functional process improvement initiatives and monitor implementation effectiveness. * Ensure operational changes are properly documented, communicated, implemented, and followed up. **4. Data Analysis & Management Support** * Consolidate operational and project data from multiple functions and prepare management reports and dashboards. * Analyze operational data, project status, and execution issues to identify trends, gaps, and areas requiring attention. * Maintain accurate and traceable records of projects, processes, decisions, and action items. * Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support management decision-making and operational planning. Requirements * **6+ years of relevant experience** in operations, project management, PMO, business process management, ERP implementation, or a related field. * Proven experience coordinating **cross-functional projects** and independently driving deliverables and follow-up actions. * Practical experience with **ERP implementation, system enhancement, process improvement, or operational transformation** . * Experience developing or maintaining **SOPs, workflows, process documentation, management reports, or operational tracking mechanisms** . * Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple functions. * Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and execution skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks through completion. * Good **English communication skills** , including reading, writing, meetings, and business documentation. * Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel** and common business tools. Preferred Qualifications * Experience working in a fast-growing or technology-driven organization. * Experience working with ERP implementation teams, IT teams, or external system vendors. * Experience in PMO, business operations, process transformation, or operational excellence. * Experience working across multiple business functions such as Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, HR, or IT. Scope of the Role This role is responsible for independently coordinating and driving assigned operational initiatives, cross-functional projects, process improvements, and ERP-related activities. You will be expected to proactively identify issues, align stakeholders, drive execution, and provide structured updates and recommendations to the Operations Director. The role does not hold final authority over major company-wide operational decisions, significant resource allocation, or management policies. Matters requiring executive-level decisions will be escalated to the appropriate leadership team.

The role ensures that project resources, information, and reporting are well managed and clearly communicated to project leadership, the Board, and lenders, supporting informed decision-making and strong project governance. experience in offshore wind is a strong plus * Proven experience leading or building a PMO or project support function, with solid people leadership, team management, and team development experience at project level * Experience establishing and maintaining PMO governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and Employer's Requirements * Experience in resource management, interface management, and project reporting at project level * Strong knowledge of structured project execution and stage-gate models and project management processes * A team player with excellent communication skills and an innovative mindset, but also the ability to work independently and lead on topics * Goal orientated, balancing task, team and individual needs to achieve the right outcome * Considerable experience working in project teams focused on complex, mixed stakeholder environments, high value projects, including Joint Ventures. Plus, if experience in the renewable energy or offshore wind industry * Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop a multidisciplinary PMO team * Strong interpersonal skills (communication, motivation, persuasion), proactive and capable of reaching out to different stakeholders, including senior leadership * Drive, enthusiasm, initiative and a willingness to develop including that of the team efficiency and effectiveness * Methodical and organized, a good facilitator and mediator able to resolve conflict * Working proficiency in English is required; Mandarin/Chinese language skills are a plus * PMP or other relevant certifications are an advantage

new_jobs.jd: 【1】崗位職責 1. **企業級平台解決方案架構設計** ：主導企業級雲原生 / 私有雲平台之整體解決方案架構與應用程式模組架構設計，涵蓋服務拆分、系統整合、部署方式、治理機制與平台標準制定，支撐集團內部應用開發、部署與營運 2. **平台方案落地與技術執行** ：將架構設計轉化為可執行方案，協同內外部團隊推進平台建置、系統整合、上線與持續優化，確保方案具備可落地、可維運與可擴展性 3. **供應商方案整合與技術管理** ：與 SI、軟硬體供應商及內部技術團隊協作，評估並整合不同產品與技術方案，處理多供應商、多模組、多系統環境下的相容性、部署方式與治理需求 4. **平台標準化與架構治理機制建立** ：規劃雲原生平台於架構、部署、版本、權限與開發流程等面向的標準化機制，提升平台於不同事業群與場域的複製效率及長期運營穩定性 5. **跨部門技術協作與問題解決** ：與平台負責人、BU 團隊、採購、PMO 及外部合作夥伴協作，推動技術決策，識別並解決平台建設過程中的風險、瓶頸與整合問題 【2】崗位要求 1. **學歷背景** ：大學以上，資訊工程、軟體工程、管理資訊系統或相關科系 2. **架構師經驗** ：具 5 年以上架構師實務經驗，且需具明確之 Solution / Application / Platform Architecture 年資 3. **軟體架構與開發經驗** ：具 8 年以上軟體架構與開發經驗，能獨立處理系統設計、模組規劃與整體技術方案落地 4. **雲原生與私有雲經驗** ：具備雲原生、私有雲方案落地與維運（DevOps）經驗，熟悉企業級平台之建置與治理方式 5. **核心技術能力** ：熟悉 Kubernetes 與雲原生技術棧，理解容器化、編排、CI/CD、DevOps 等平台級技術能力，其中 Kubernetes 為核心要求 6. **供應商協作經驗** ：具外部供應商 / SI 協作經驗，曾參與大型平台、系統整合或解決方案落地專案 7. **證照條件** ：具 TOGAF 或同等架構認證者優先 【3】理想人選條件 1. **平台建置經驗** ：曾主導或深度參與企業級平台、私有雲平台或雲原生平台建置專案 2. **整合與落地經驗** ：具多供應商產品整合與技術落地經驗，能在複雜環境中承接整體解決方案導入 3. **架構表達能力** ：能清楚說明過往專案中的架構設計邏輯、技術選型原因、實際部署情境與運作方式

new_jobs.title: Field Application Engineer(FAE) / 應用工程師
new_jobs.jd: **About Calyx** Calyx is a precision-sensing company founded out of UC Berkeley in 2014. We build AI-enabled camera and sensor systems that turn real-time flock data into actionable decisions for the poultry industry — helping producers monitor animal welfare, optimize harvest scheduling, and capture measurable ROI. Our Taiwan Engineering Center in Taipei is where our hardware comes to life, and our systems run on farms across Asia and the Americas. **About the Role** We're looking for a Field Application Engineer (FAE) who thrives where engineering meets the real world. You'll be the technical bridge between our products and our customers — deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting intelligent sensing systems in live production environments, including poultry and swine farms. When a system you installed starts delivering insights a farm has never had before, that win is yours. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for someone who enjoys solving problems in the field, not just at a desk. **What You'll Do** * Install, configure, and test camera and sensor systems at customer sites, and see deployments through to stable operation * Provide onsite and remote technical support to customers and internal teams * Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues in field conditions * Lead customer training sessions and live product demonstrations * Drive system validation, pilot deployments, and proof-of-concept projects * Channel customer feedback and field insights back to our engineering team to shape the product roadmap * Produce field reports, deployment documentation, and improvement recommendations **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering (EE, CE, ME, CS) or a related technical field — or equivalent hands-on experience * Strong troubleshooting instincts across hardware and networking * Professional English proficiency (reading, writing, and spoken) for working with international teams and customers * Clear communicator who can translate technical concepts for both engineers and farm operators * Self-driven and adaptable — comfortable working independently on the road and in the field * Comfortable working in agricultural environments, including poultry and swine farms (biosecurity protocols apply) * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel ~20–30%, including international business trips **Nice to Have** * Hands-on experience with IP cameras, embedded systems, sensors, or industrial equipment * Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, or edge computing * Background in agriculture, robotics, IoT, or industrial automation * Additional languages beyond English and Mandarin **Why Join Us** * Work on AI and sensing technology that creates visible, measurable impact in the real world * Small, senior team with direct access to engineering and leadership — your field insights shape the product * Cross-border exposure: collaborate with teams and customers across Taiwan, the US, and beyond * Competitive compensation package
